The prime factorization of 2 is 2.
The prime factorization of 3 is 3.
The prime factorization of 4 is 2^2.
To find the LCM, we take the highest power of each prime factor that appears in any of the factorizations.
So, the LCM of 2, 3, and 4 is 2^2 * 3 = 4 * 3 = 12.
Therefore, the shortest time after which the three bulbs will be on at the same time is 12 seconds.
